newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan real estate shares rise on land price hopes.
newsitem.headline: Japan real estate shares rise on land price hopes.

text.p: Shares in Japan's real estate sector rose in the Thursday morning session, fuelled by hopes that the decline in land prices in urban areas may be over, brokers said.
Interest in domestic-demand centred shares also supported the sector, they said.
As of 0140 GMT, the real estate sector 0#REA.T was the largest gaining sector.
Mitsui Fudosan Co Ltd was the most heavily traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo bourse with 4.55 million shares traded. It rose 20 yen to 1,490.
Mitsubishi Estate Co Ltd was also up 20 yen at 1,660.
